latest.name: Moises — AI Stem Separation & Music Practice App
latest.category: Voice, speech, music and audio AI
latest.short_verdict: Moises is a musician-focused AI practice and production app that separates an existing song into vocal and instrument stems, detects key/BPM/chords, and lets users adjust pitch and tempo. The free plan allows five uploads/separations per month, up to five minutes per file, with preset 2- or 4-stem separation. It is especially useful for practice, karaoke and backing tracks, but the free limits are tight and independent testing found audible artefacts in vocal stems.
latest.what_it_does: Moises is an AI-powered music practice and production workspace for web, Android, iOS and desktop. It can split an uploaded audio track into vocals and instrumental, or vocals, drums, bass and other; detect key and BPM; display chords; create a synchronized metronome; and let musicians slow down, speed up or transpose a track for practice. Its newer browser-based Studio adds multitrack recording, arrangement, collaboration and AI-generated supporting stems. It is designed to help musicians work with recordings they already have, rather than simply generate a complete song from a text prompt.
latest.why_try_it: It combines stem separation with the practical tools musicians need after separation: mute or solo parts, practise against a drumless or bassless backing track, identify chords and key, and adjust tempo or pitch. Five short uploads per month are enough to evaluate the workflow without paying, and the official Android app makes it convenient for practice away from a computer.
latest.free_tier: The current official Free offer lists 5 AI audio separations per month. The Help Center separately confirms up to 5 uploaded files per month, with a monthly reset; deleting an upload does not restore its slot. Each free stem-separation file can be up to 5 minutes. Free separation has two presets: 2 stems (vocals and instrumental) or 4 stems (vocals, drums, bass and other). Free users also have pitch/tempo controls and key/BPM detection; chord detection, Smart Metronome and lyrics transcription are limited to the first minute of a song.
latest.limits: The five monthly upload slots are shared across the month and deleted files still count. Free stem separation is capped at 5 minutes per file and offers only the 2- or 4-stem presets; selecting individual instruments such as guitar, piano or strings requires Premium or Pro. Chords, Smart Metronome and lyrics transcription work only on the first minute for Free users. Free files are retained for two months from the last actual login and may then be deleted. Web/desktop WAV export is Premium-only; mobile export options include MP3 and M4A. Streaming-service URLs such as Spotify or Apple Music are not accepted for separation: upload only audio you own or are legally allowed to modify. There is also an unresolved official-plan discrepancy for AI Studio/Stem Generation credits: the current promotional page says 60 monthly credits, while the Help Center credit explainer says 10 for Free users, so that separate allowance should be checked in-app rather than treated as a reliable quota.
latest.signup_pakistan: No Pakistan-specific signup prohibition was found in the public pages reviewed, and Moises describes its service as worldwide. However, a Pakistan-based signup was not hands-on tested. Its payment-options article lists international Visa/Mastercard brands, PayPal, App Store and Google Play, but does not confirm acceptance by Pakistani card issuers or Pakistan-specific store billing. The official Play listing was verified, but availability in the Pakistan Play Store was not independently confirmed.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claims: Moises says more than 80 million musicians use its tools worldwide; its official stem-separation page describes 27 stem targets at the highest tier, and says user uploads are not used to train its models. Google Play displays the official app with a 4.5-star rating and 50M+ downloads (the review count is roughly 430K). Independent hands-on test: MusicRadar's 7 January 2026 comparison fed three different mixed songs through 11 stem-separation tools at their highest settings and used listening plus phase-cancellation checks. Moises received an honourable mention rather than a top-five score; reviewers found drum and bass extraction good but vocal extraction affected by warbling, clicks and spill from other stems. Anecdotal feedback: recent Google Play reviews include praise for vocal isolation, alongside complaints about paid feature gates, importing personal files and occasional subscription-state prompts. These reviews are individual experiences, not controlled tests. No hands-on generation test was performed for this report.
latest.android_status: Official Android app verified: “Moises: The Musician's AI App” by Moises Systems, Inc., package ai.moises. Google Play displayed a 4.5-star rating, about 430K reviews and 50M+ downloads when checked on 2026-11-26. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not confirmed.
